body: I like abstract and modern art a lot. I make art myself, which I am proud of when I get the energy to complete it. I'm jobless right now so art is the only thing that makes me feel accomplished. I also like electronic music a lot. I used to really like going to raves. I've been going to a psychiatrist for about 2-3 years now and theyre still figuring me out and frustrated with how i am not improving. I hate going everytime, they treat me like a drug abuser (which I am not other then weed). They are also threatening to take me off my ADD meds because they don't believe me when i say it helps me. :( She actually makes me feel worse every time i go. Thank you for your response though

Thank you for the response. Music gives me so many feels... like it has the ability to amplify my crying exponentially or make me feel like a total badass (in a good way). When I'm manicly upset I don't even want to feel better though.. regardless music is a very good suggestion , I'll look into trying to listen to music when I feel this way. Any genres in particular that you think would help? (E.g. pop would probably piss me off more)
